services.value: Provides microbiological testing services for food, feed, and ingredient industries, including environmental monitoring, product and ingredient testing, routine analytical testing, and special projects. Listed analyses include E. coli, O157:H7, Salmonella species, Listeria monocytogenes and species, Staphylococcus aureus, aerobic plate count, yeast & mold, coliforms, enterobacteriaceae, and lactic acid bacteria.
